title: Halo Dental newsletter
description: Crisp white two-column newsletter signup band: a large two-line display heading on the left, paired on the right with a notched floating-label email input, a privacy consent checkbox with underlined policy links, and a quiet stone submit button.
notes: uses bg-card (#ffffff in halodental-theme) so the band stands out cleanly against the warm-stone page and the dark footer below
